```{r}
data_dir = "/Users/debda22/OneDrive - Linköpings universitet/T1D_vitamin_D_results/cox_analysis/concentrations/"

df_cox_full <- read.table(paste0(data_dir,"age20/long_format_cox_age_full.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scenario= "full follow-up")

df_cox_full_boy <- read.table(paste0(data_dir,"age20/boy/long_format_cox_age_full_boy.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scenario= "boy-only full follow-up")

df_cox_full_girl <- read.table(paste0(data_dir,"age20/girl/long_format_cox_age_full_girl.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scenario= "girl-only full follow-up")

df_cox_age_5 <- read.table(paste0(data_dir,"age5/long_format_cox_age_5.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scenario= "age 5")

df_cox_age_10 <- read.table(paste0(data_dir,"age10/long_format_cox_age_10.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scenario= "age 10")

df_cox_age_15 <- read.table(paste0(data_dir,"age15/long_format_cox_age_15.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scenario= "age 15")
```

```{r}
# List of your separate data.frames for each scenario
scenarios <- list(
  "Full follow-up"   = df_cox_full,
  "Boys only"        = df_cox_full_boy,
  "Girls only"       = df_cox_full_girl,
  "Up to 5 years"    = df_cox_age_5,
  "Up to 10 years"   = df_cox_age_10,
  "Up to 15 years"   = df_cox_age_15
)
```

Fit Cox models and generate survival curves
```{r}
fits <- map(setNames(names(scenarios), names(scenarios)), function(name) {
  dat <- scenarios[[name]]
  
  # If age-limited scenario, truncate follow-up
  if (grepl("Up to", name)) {
    max_age <- as.numeric(gsub(".*Up to (\\d+).*", "\\1", name))
    
    # Create truncated follow-up and event indicator
    dat$exit_age_trunc <- pmin(dat$exit_age, max_age)
    dat$event_trunc    <- dat$event * (dat$exit_age <= max_age)
    
    # Fit Cox on truncated data
    fit <- coxph(Surv(exit_age_trunc, event_trunc) ~ conc_25OHD, data = dat)
    
    # Survfit for median conc_25OHD
    newdata <- data.frame(conc_25OHD = median(dat$conc_25OHD, na.rm = TRUE))
    survfit(fit, newdata = newdata)
    
  } else {
    # Full follow-up / sex-stratified
    fit <- coxph(Surv(exit_age, event) ~ conc_25OHD, data = dat)
    newdata <- data.frame(conc_25OHD = median(dat$conc_25OHD, na.rm = TRUE))
    survfit(fit, newdata = newdata)
  }
})
```

Overlay plot (all scenarios in one figure)
```{r}
# ---- Panel 1: Full + Boys + Girls ----
panel1 <- ggsurvplot_combine(
  fit          = fits[c("Full follow-up", "Boys only", "Girls only")],
  legend.title = "",
  legend.labs  = c("Full follow-up", "Boys only", "Girls only"),
  palette      = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3"),
  ggtheme      = theme_light(),
  risk.table   = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# ---- Panel 2: Full + 5y + 10y + 15y ----
panel2 <- ggsurvplot_combine(
  fit          = fits[c("Full follow-up", "Up to 5 years", "Up to 10 years", "Up to 15 years")],
  legend.title = "Follow-up",
  legend.labs  = c("Full", "Up to 5y", "Up to 10y", "Up to 15y"),
  palette      = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a"),
  ggtheme      = theme_light(),
  risk.table   = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# --- Arrange 2x2 layout ---
layout <- "
AB
CD
"

final_plot <- panel1$plot + panel2$plot +
              panel1$table + panel2$table +
              plot_layout(design = layout, heights = c(2, 1))

final_plot
```

```{r}
# ---- Arrange panels into one figure ----

combined_panels <- panel1$plot / panel2$plot + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
combined_panels
```
